requirements.title: SPLIT argument restrictions and intents
requirements.definition: STRING and SET shall be scalar character of the same kind, POS shall be integer scalar with the specified range and INTENT(INOUT), and BACK shall be optional logical scalar.

pending.SPLIT-STRING-character-scalar: Positive controls pass scalar character STRING values; source-control mutations use character arrays and noncharacter STRING actuals and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SPLIT-SET-character-scalar-same-kind: Positive controls pass scalar SET with the same kind as STRING; source-control mutations use mismatched kind, array SET, and noncharacter SET and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SPLIT-POS-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive controls initialize POS at forward and backward boundary values; source-control mutations use noninteger, nonscalar, and out-of-range POS values and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SPLIT-BACK-logical-scalar: Positive controls omit BACK and pass scalar .true. and .false.; source-control mutations use integer or logical-array BACK and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SPLIT-argument-intents: Initialize STRING and SET sentinels, call SPLIT, assert only POS changes while STRING and SET remain equal to their pre-call values, and mutate the expected unchanged values so the check fails.

requirements.title: SPLIT SET characters delimit possibly zero-length tokens
requirements.definition: Each character in SET is a token delimiter; delimiter-separated sequences, including leading, trailing, and consecutive delimiters, define tokens with zero or more characters.

pending.SPLIT-SET-characters-are-delimiters: Use string ",alpha,,beta," and SET=","; repeated forward calls assert delimiter POS values 1, 7, 8, 13, and LEN+1; mutate SET to ";" so positions fail.
pending.SPLIT-zero-length-leading-token: Start POS at 0 for ",alpha" and assert the first returned POS is 1, yielding token bounds 1:0 after sentinel initialization.
pending.SPLIT-zero-length-consecutive-token: Start from the delimiter before the second comma in "alpha,,beta" and assert the next returned POS identifies bounds with start greater than end.
pending.SPLIT-zero-length-trailing-token: Start POS at the final delimiter of "alpha," and assert the next returned POS is LEN+1, yielding trailing bounds with start greater than end.

requirements.title: SPLIT forward scan assigns POS to the next delimiter or LEN plus one
requirements.definition: With BACK absent or false, SPLIT assigns POS to the leftmost token delimiter after the incoming POS, or to LEN(STRING)+1 with no later delimiter, identifying token start and end positions.

pending.SPLIT-forward-no-delimiter-LEN-plus-one: Continue forward scanning after the last delimiter, assert POS becomes LEN(STRING)+1 from a nondefault sentinel, and mutate the expected terminal value.
pending.SPLIT-forward-token-bounds: Track previous POS plus one and returned POS minus one for "one,last example"; assert tokens "one", "last", and "example" with character sentinels.
